Name: Toffee's Parrots
Author: Toffeeko
Description:
I saw that there were some parrot mods, but none of them used the (extremely cute!) canon parrot sprite. When I went into the unpacked SDV files, I sort of saw why. The parrots had no walking sprites! So I made my own, as well as adding more parrot varieties to choose from. The parrots, and their produce, are as follows:

[center][b]Island Parrot[/b][/center][center](This is the canon SDV parrot.)
[spoiler]Rainbow Feather[/spoiler]

[b]Cockatoo[/b]
[spoiler]White Feather[/spoiler]

[b]Cockatiel
[/b][spoiler]White Feather[/spoiler]

[b]Peach-Faced Lovebird[/b][/center][center]﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿(Green and blue variants available.)
[spoiler]Green Feather and Blue Feather, depending on the variant.[/spoiler]﻿﻿

[b]Black-Masked Lovebird
[/b](Green and blue variants available.)
[spoiler]Green Feather and Blue Feather, depending on the variant.[/spoiler]﻿

[b]African Grey Parrot
[/b][spoiler]Red Feather[/spoiler]

[b]Void Parrot[/b]
[spoiler]Black Feather[/spoiler]

[b]All parrots can produce a rare item:[/b]
[spoiler]Gilded Quill[/spoiler]

[b]NEW UPDATE! Parrot produce can now be turned into a new Artisan Good!
[/b][spoiler]Parrot Feathers will now make paint of their corresponding color when put into an oil maker.[/spoiler][/center]

[b]IMPORTANT: This mod requires the unofficial Better Farm Animal Variety (BFAV) update! A link is provided below (you will have to scroll to find it):
[/b][url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-68]Unofficial Update Link

[/url][b]As the BFAV unofficial update is not compatible with Android, this mod is also incompatible.[/b]

Manifest.Name: (BFAV) Parrots
Manifest.Description: Adds parrots as a farm animal option.
Manifest.Author: Toffeeko

Manifest.Name: (PFM) Parrot Machine Goods
Manifest.Description: Allows the creation of Parrot Paint via the Oil Maker.
Manifest.Author: Toffeeko
